issues.description: The template's Farm.singFarmSongVerse method declares no parameter (the Animal parameter is commented out), while the problem statement UML and the solution both define singFarmSongVerse to accept an Animal parameter. This mismatch can confuse students implementing singFarmSong() because they will be expected to call singFarmSongVerse(animal). They might either (a) change the existing template method signature, (b) add an overloaded method, or (c) be unsure how to proceed — all creating unnecessary friction.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the template method signature to match the specification and solution: replace the commented parameter with an explicit Animal parameter (private void singFarmSongVerse(Animal animal)) and update the method body placeholders to use that parameter. This aligns the template with the UML and the reference solution and avoids student confusion.
